title: Point and tangent separation implies very ampleness on a curve
statement: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field, let $C$ be a proper smooth connected curve over $k$, and let $\mathcal M$ be a line bundle on $C$ [def-sc-curves] [def-sc-invertible-module]. Suppose that for every $k$-rational point $P$ one has $\dim_k H^0(C,\mathcal M(-P))=\dim_k H^0(C,\mathcal M)-1$, and for every pair of (not necessarily distinct) $k$-rational points $P,Q$ one has $\dim_k H^0(C,\mathcal M(-P-Q))=\dim_k H^0(C,\mathcal M)-2$, where $\mathcal M(-P-Q)=\mathcal M\otimes\mathcal O_C(-[P]-[Q])$ uses the divisor-module convention of [def-sc-divisor] and the degree convention of [def-sc-pic0]. Then $\mathcal M$ is very ample [def-sc-ample].

source.place: Tag 0E8S, lemma-separate-points-tangent-vectors (point and tangent separation implies very ampleness); equivalent dimension-drop hypotheses as stated by AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.isVeryAmple_of_finrankH_zero_tensorObj_toModules_ker, WeilConjectures/AlgebraicGeometry/Curve/RiemannRoch.lean:1405-1511

proof.text: Set $V=H^0(C,\mathcal M)$. For a closed point $P$, algebraic closedness makes $P$ $k$-rational. The divisor-module definition [def-sc-divisor] identifies $H^0(C,\mathcal M(-P))$ with the sections of $V$ vanishing at $P$. The first dimension-drop hypothesis makes this subspace a hyperplane, so evaluation at $P$ is nonzero. In particular, $V$ has no base point at a closed point. The proper-coherent finiteness needed to take a basis of $V$ is included in [lem-sc-point-tangent-separation-closed-immersion].

source.place: Tag 0E8S, lemma-separate-points-tangent-vectors, proof, first paragraph; the dimension-drop translation follows the second paragraph of blueprint node lem-sc-degree-2g1-very-ample

proof.text: If $P\ne Q$, [def-sc-divisor] identifies $H^0(C,\mathcal M(-P-Q))$ with the subspace of $H^0(C,\mathcal M(-P))$ whose sections also vanish at $Q$. The hypotheses give these nested spaces codimensions $2$ and $1$ in $V$, respectively. Choose $s$ in the latter but outside the former. Then $s(P)=0$ and $s(Q)\ne0$, giving condition (1) of [lem-sc-point-tangent-separation-closed-immersion] for every ordered pair of distinct closed points.

source.place: proof, second paragraph: separation of distinct points

proof.text: Put $Q=P$. The same codimension calculation gives $s\in H^0(C,\mathcal M(-P))\setminus H^0(C,\mathcal M(-2P))$. By [lem-sc-point-cartier], $P$ is an effective Cartier divisor. Its ideal at $P$ is $\mathfrak m_P=(t)$ with $t$ a uniformizer, because the smooth curve has a one-dimensional discrete valuation local ring by [lem-sc-smooth-regular] and [lem-sc-regular-dim1-dvr]. Hence [def-sc-divisor] says that, in a local frame of $\mathcal M$, the germ of $s$ is $tu$ for some unit $u$: it lies in $\mathfrak m_P$ but not $\mathfrak m_P^2$. Its class in $\mathfrak m_P/\mathfrak m_P^2$ is nonzero. This cotangent space is one-dimensional, so every nonzero tangent vector evaluates it nontrivially. Thus $s$ satisfies condition (2) of [lem-sc-point-tangent-separation-closed-immersion].

source.place: proof, second paragraph: separation of tangent vectors by subtracting the same point twice

proof.text: Apply [lem-sc-point-tangent-separation-closed-immersion] to the proper $k$-scheme $C$, the invertible module $\mathcal M$, and the full finite-dimensional space $V=H^0(C,\mathcal M)$. Step 1 gives (0), steps 2 and 3 give (1) and (2); the criterion gives a closed immersion of the complete linear system $C\to\mathbf P(V^\vee)$ pulling $\mathcal O(1)$ back to $\mathcal M$. This is very ampleness by [def-sc-ample].

lean.statement: theorem veryAmple_of_divisor_dimension_drops (k : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] (C : Scheme.{u}) (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsConnectedCurve f] [Smooth f] [IsProper f] (M : C.Modules) [M.IsInvertible] (h₁ : ∀ P : closedPoints C, Module.finrank k ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ f.appTop).hom).obj ((M ⊗ Divisor.moduleOfSmoothConnectedCurve k C f (Finsupp.single P (-1))).val.obj (Opposite.op ⊤))) + 1 = Module.finrank k ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ f.appTop).hom).obj (M.val.obj (Opposite.op ⊤)))) (h₂ : ∀ P Q : closedPoints C, Module.finrank k ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ f.appTop).hom).obj ((M ⊗ Divisor.moduleOfSmoothConnectedCurve k C f (Finsupp.single P (-1) + Finsupp.single Q (-1))).val.obj (Opposite.op ⊤))) + 2 = Module.finrank k ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ f.appTop).hom).obj (M.val.obj (Opposite.op ⊤)))) : IsVeryAmple f M ∧ ∃ (I : Type u) (_ : Finite I) (b : Module.Basis I k ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ f.appTop).hom).obj (M.val.obj (Opposite.op ⊤)))) (s : I → M.sections), (∀ i : I, (s i).val (Opposite.op ⊤) = b i) ∧ ∃ hs : Epi (M.freeHomEquiv.symm s), IsClosedImmersion (ProjectiveSpace.homOfGeneratingSections I f M s hs) ∧ Nonempty (ProjectiveSpace.twistRestrict (ProjectiveSpace.homOfGeneratingSections I f M s hs) 1 ≅ M)
